title: agents-team: canonical agent definition (frontmatter of agents/<name>.md)
description: Harness-neutral. Adapters translate it into each harness's native format. Scopes reference .agents-team.yml keys (paths.*, commands.*) so they resolve per target repo.

invocation.description: orchestrator = called by a workflow; human = only by direct user request.

phases.description: Phases this agent runs in. Each phase may get its own model in team config.

default_model.description: Fallback when team config has no entry. String or per-phase map.

write.description: Per-phase write scopes. Missing phase = no repo writes.

shell.description: Allowed commands: commands.* keys, security.tools, or literal git subcommands (git:status, git:diff, ...).

mcp.description: MCP servers and access level. Agents never get write access to external systems.

scopes.description: repo, artifacts, teaching, or a .agents-team.yml path key (paths.tests, ...).

artifacts.description: Artifact file names under cards/<CARD>/ (iteration files are relative to iterations/NN/).
